articles.title: Washington Goes All-In on Crypto: Trump Pushes Clarity, SEC Rules, and CFTC Warnings
articles.snippet: Trump urged executives to pass a "fair version" of the Clarity Act, the CFTC warned it would write its own rules if the bill stalls, and the SEC abruptly advanced its first crypto fundraising framework.

articles.title: Most Americans Say Trump's Crypto Profits Cross the Line: Poll
articles.snippet: A Reuters/Ipsos survey found 63% of Americans view the Trump family's crypto profits as inappropriate, with even half of the president's fellow Republicans saying his business interests sway his decisions.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Hyperliquid Is Coming to the US
articles.snippet: At least, if Trump and the CFTC have their way. And the market really, really liked the news.
